source: docs/ai-fusion/bgbh-analyst/planning/01_百购商场分析体系.md §主题一/口径字典
notes: 分类按主题：总盘/排名/结构/坪效；时间粒度用问法变体覆盖，不拆日报周报月报
金额默认 sale_amt；去券 sale_uncpn_amt；去税 sale_uncpn_taxout_amt
sale_avg_price=件单价，不是客单价；毛利率用金额加权或预计算列
日期 T+1；stats_date 按 yyyy-MM-dd 字符串比较
经营模式只做 GROUP BY，不做未签字枚举等值过滤
门店号样本用 store_id（示例 0027，平台核对清单用号）；与 store_name 样本成对，勿混用店名过滤

pairs.remark: [S1-A1a] 昨日全店销售金额+笔数
pairs.question: 昨天百货销售额是多少？
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_amt) AS 销售额, SUM(sale_cnt) AS 销售笔数 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')

pairs.question: 昨天卖了多少
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_amt) AS 销售额, SUM(sale_cnt) AS 销售笔数 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')

pairs.question: 昨日全店销售业绩
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_amt) AS 销售额, SUM(sale_cnt) AS 销售笔数 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')

pairs.question: 上周销售去券去税金额
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_uncpn_taxout_amt) AS 去券去税金额 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')

pairs.question: 本月累计销售额是多少
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_amt) AS 本月累计销售额 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-01') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')

pairs.question: 昨天去券销售额是多少
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_uncpn_amt) AS 去券销售额 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')

pairs.question: 昨天销售环比前日是涨是跌？
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT SUM(IF(stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d'), sale_amt, 0)) AS 昨日, SUM(IF(stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d'), sale_amt, 0)) AS 前日, SUM(IF(stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d'), sale_amt, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(IF(stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d'), sale_amt, 0)), 0) - 1 AS 环比 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date IN (DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d'))

pairs.question: 今年哪个月销售额最高？
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(stats_date, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, SUM(sale_amt) AS 销售额 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date LIKE CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y'), '%') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(stats_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

pairs.question: 八佰伴镇江店昨天销售额是多少
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT store_name, SUM(sale_amt) AS 销售额, SUM(sale_cnt) AS 销售笔数 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AND store_name = '八佰伴镇江店' GROUP BY store_name

pairs.question: 八佰伴镇江店本月累计销售额
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT store_name, SUM(sale_amt) AS 本月累计销售额 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-01') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AND store_name = '八佰伴镇江店' GROUP BY store_name

pairs.wren_sql: SELECT store_name, SUM(sale_amt) AS 销售额 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY store_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

pairs.wren_sql: SELECT store_name, SUM(sale_amt) AS 销售额 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY store_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

pairs.question: 昨天各门店销售笔数排名
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT store_name, SUM(sale_cnt) AS 销售笔数 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY store_name ORDER BY 销售笔数 DESC

pairs.question: 昨天各商户销售排名
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT business_name, SUM(sale_amt) AS 销售额 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY business_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

pairs.question: 昨天各品牌销售金额排名
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT brand_name, SUM(sale_amt) AS 销售额 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY brand_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

pairs.question: 昨天折扣率最高的五个品牌
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT brand_name, SUM(sale_discount_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(sale_amt), 0) AS 加权折扣率 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY brand_name ORDER BY 加权折扣率 DESC

pairs.question: 上个月各大类销售毛利和毛利率
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT main_category_name, SUM(sale_gross_profit) AS 毛利, SUM(sale_gross_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(sale_amt), 0) AS 毛利率 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND DATE_FORMAT(LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY main_category_name ORDER BY 毛利 DESC

pairs.question: 昨天各经营模式销售额
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT operate_mode, SUM(sale_amt) AS 销售额 FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY operate_mode ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

pairs.question: 上月销售额超过100万的品牌有几个？
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 品牌数 FROM (SELECT brand_id FROM ads_trd_mall_sale_d_df WHERE stats_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND DATE_FORMAT(LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY brand_id HAVING SUM(sale_amt) > 1000000) t

pairs.question: 各门店女装品类坪效排名
pairs.wren_sql: SELECT store_name, sales_per_square_meter AS 销售坪效 FROM ads_csmr_store_brand_whole_sale_df WHERE stats_period = 'year' AND mid_category_name = '女装' ORDER BY 销售坪效 DESC

pairs.question: 八佰伴镇江店品牌销售毛利率和回款率
